<a id="actionsfeature"></a>

## `ActionsFeature`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Actions.ActionsFeature` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

The action runner in the running game: installs it on [`ActionServices.Shared`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Actions.md#actionservices--shared), finds the [`ActionFamilyAttribute`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Actions.md#actionfamilyattribute) families in the framework's assemblies on the first frame, registers the `act` console command and the smoke checks, and publishes every finished call as an `ACTION` audit line.

Every caller goes through the same door: `ActionServices.Shared.RunAsync(request)` (the console's `act run`, scripts' `cwy.do`, the local API, mods through `helper.Actions`). The gate's switches come from the plugins that own them ([`ActionServices.UseWritesSwitch`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Actions.md#actionservices--usewritesswitch), [`ActionServices.UseApiActionsSwitch`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Actions.md#actionservices--useapiactionsswitch)); confirmations from the in-game dialog once one is installed ([`ActionServices.UseConfirmationGate`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Actions.md#actionservices--useconfirmationgate)), until then every Confirm verdict ends Declined.

Config `[Actions] Enabled` (true). Off: no runner is installed, so every call answers NotAvailable; `act` still explains why. Static and initialised once from the core plugin's Awake, on the main thread.

<a id="actionsfeature--discoverfamilies"></a>

### `static IReadOnlyList<ActionFamilyOutcome> DiscoverFamilies(Assembly assembly)`

Finds and registers the families of an assembly that loads after the first frame (a plugin loaded on demand). Main thread only; each family is registered once however often this runs.

**Parameters**

- `assembly`: The assembly.

**Returns:** The outcomes of the families new in it; empty when off or off the main thread.

<a id="actionsfeature--initialize"></a>

### `static void Initialize(ConfigFile config)`

Binds the config, registers `act` and the smoke checks, installs the runner and schedules family discovery for the first frame. Idempotent. Call on the main thread, after `MainThread.Arm`.

**Parameters**

- `config`: The core plugin's config file.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: `config` is null.

The `act status` text: runner, switches, confirmation, families, counters, self-test.
